title: Code view
text: Use the </> button to open Code. This is the part of the app used throughout the guide to work with research folders, scripts, and software.

title: Sessions
text: Choose New to begin a conversation with the agent. Search helps you find an earlier session so you can return to that work.

title: Start a session
text: Choose the project folder and the environment where the agent will run its tools. The same choices appear below the message box.

title: Describe the work
text: Tell the agent what you want it to do and what the result should be. For example: “Change the figure’s x-axis label to Maternal age (years), then regenerate it.”

title: Where tools run
text: “This computer” means the agent runs tools on your machine. The LLM runs on Anthropic’s servers, so project content the agent supplies to it is sent to Anthropic.

title: Project folder
text: Choose the folder containing the project you want to work on. This is where the session starts; it is not, by itself, a restriction on every file the agent can access.

title: Model
text: Choose the LLM used for the session. Available LLMs depend on your account and change over time.

title: Reasoning effort
text: Where available, this setting controls how much reasoning the LLM uses. Higher effort can help with difficult tasks, but may take longer and use more of your allowance.

title: Permission mode
text: This setting controls how actions are approved. Auto is the mode shown here; the settings chapter explains the available choices.

title: Usage
text: In the app, click this circle to see the percentage of your weekly allowance used and when it resets.

title: Research account
text: Check that you are signed into the account intended for your research. An institutional account can have different access and data terms from a personal account.

title: Settings
text: Open the app’s settings. Later chapters explain which settings affect access to files and tools, and how independently the agent can work.
